eas_text: A civil authority has issued A FIRE WARNING for the following counties or areas: Columbia; Asotin; Adams; Stevens; Whitman; Pend Oreille; Lincoln; Ferry; Garfield; Spokane, WA; at 9:33 PM on AUG 16, 2021 Effective until 9:33 PM AUG 17, 2021. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: This is a new message from the Stevens County Sheriff's Office and Fire District #1. This is a level 3 evacuation, leave immediately, for the area from Ford south to the county line and east along the river to Tum Tum. The fire continues to be fast moving. Again, this is a level 3 evacuation, leave immediately notice. The Red Cross shelter has been changed to the Deer Park High School.
